definitions.gloss: stopping, halting (of a train, car, or vehicle)
definitions.explanation: The act of a vehicle coming to a stop, especially at a station or designated place.

examples.japanese: この{電車|でんしゃ}は{各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}です。
examples.english: This train stops at every station.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}ブレーキで{急|きゅう}{停車|ていしゃ}した。
examples.english: The train made an emergency stop.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{停車|ていしゃ}{駅|えき}は{東京|とうきょう}です。
{信号|しんごう}が{赤|あか}になったので、{車|くるま}を{停車|ていしゃ}させた。
examples.english: I stopped the car because the traffic light turned red.

examples.japanese: この{特急|とっきゅう}は{途中|とちゅう}{停車|ていしゃ}しないので、{終点|しゅうてん}まで{早|はや}く{着|つ}きます。
examples.english: This express train doesn't stop along the way, so it arrives at the final station quickly.

notes:
{停車|ていしゃ} is used for vehicles, especially trains, stopping.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {停車|ていしゃ}する: to stop (of a vehicle)
- {各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}: local train (stopping at all stations)
- {急|きゅう}{停車|ていしゃ}: sudden stop, emergency stop
- {停車|ていしゃ}{駅|えき}: stop, station where the train stops

CONTRAST:
- {停車|ていしゃ}: stopping (of a vehicle)
- {発車|はっしゃ}: departure (of a vehicle)
- {通過|つうか}: passing through

[Register: Neutral]
